filters.rationale: Only rows that passed the v1.2.2 conservative quality audit are ranked in the pilot summary.

objectives.rationale: Lower Materials Project energy-above-hull values are used here only as a descriptive stability-proxy screening objective.

limitations: This is a 50-row local pilot with reconstructed query provenance.
The dataset contains multinary Fe/Si-containing Materials Project records, not binary-only Fe-Si data.
Scores rank already available computed properties; they are not predictions and do not prove synthesizability or experimental performance.
No composition descriptors, model training, train/test validation, or virtual experiment prediction are included in v1.2.3.
notes: The default pilot uses one objective to keep the screening interpretation transparent.
Identifier and formula columns are display/provenance fields only, not numeric screening objectives.
Thresholds and objective directions should be changed only through this spec, not by hard-coding them in scripts.
